name_reason: Name follows the fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and reflects the function: an input domain blocking wait-for-keypress routine. The '_v2' suffix is a variant disambiguator (not Ghidra address residue: it is neither the function address 0x12dac nor any data address), distinguishing this per-call-tick variant from the sibling fd2_wait_for_input_with_idle @ 0x11aa8 which has a near-identical body but persists redraw-tick state in globals. Name is established/stable and consistent across the source, plate, and the sibling's docs; kept to avoid churn across protos.h and the sole caller. A more descriptive alternative (e.g. _with_idle_localtick) is conceivable but not required since '_v2' validly conveys domain+action and carries no address residue.
purpose: Block until keyboard input is available, running the palette-cycle animation and re-compositing the battle frame once per BIOS tick during the idle wait; then read the raw scancode via INT 16h AH=10h and remap a few extended scancodes before returning the scancode.
logic_summary: Idle loop: while fd2_check_keyboard_buffer_nonempty()==0, call fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim(); and if the per-call local tick (last_tick) differs from the BIOS midnight-tick word (0:046C), call fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) and latch last_tick to the current tick (drives an ~18.2 Hz redraw). On a pending key, set data_fd2_input_key_input_mode=0x10 (INT 16h AH=10h read-enhanced-keyboard preset) and call int386(0x16, &data_fd2_input_last_key_pressed, &data_fd2_input_last_key_pressed); then read the AH scancode back from data_fd2_input_key_input_mode and remap: 0xE0 or 0x52 -> 0x1C (Enter), then 0x53 -> 0x01 (Esc). Return the (possibly remapped) scancode. The redraw-tick local lives in ESI which the routine PUSH/POP-saves; ESI is NOT initialized in the body, so the binary seeds last_tick from the incoming ESI (the sole caller's target_iter, an arbitrary option index); the rebuilt source uses 0. This only affects whether the FIRST idle iteration redraws before the first tick change -- display/palette-anim only; converges immediately and never affects the return value, game state, RNG, or save data.

returns.semantics: The keyboard scancode (BIOS INT 16h AH value), after remapping 0xE0/0x52 -> 0x1C (Enter) and 0x53 -> 0x01 (Esc). The sole caller treats it as a scancode (ESC 0x01, ENTER 0x1c, SPACE 0x39, Z/keypad 0x2c/0x4c, arrows 0x48/0x50/0x4b/0x4d). Underlying value is the AH byte read from data_fd2_input_key_input_mode.

notes: void function: no parameters. The decompiler's in_stack_00000000/04/08 are artifacts of the __CHK(0x18) stack-probe calling convention (Watcom stack-overflow check), not real parameters; signature is (void). BIOS_TICK_WORD in the source is the 16-bit word at 0:046C (Ghidra _DAT_0000046c). Source comment block (input.c lines 447-477) is already accurate, matches the decompilation, and documents the load-bearing ESI-seed equivalence subtlety (per-call junk seed vs our 0, bounded to one possible iteration-1 redraw, display-only), so it is kept verbatim; input.c is therefore unchanged by this symbol. Ghidra plate is detailed and fully consistent with the refined understanding (same body, same ESI-seed reasoning, same caller), so left untouched. Sole caller fd2_wait_for_action_target_input @ 0x115b6 consumes the result as a scancode. No logic or equivalence concerns. Pre-existing modified/untracked files from prior runs are outside this symbol's staging scope.
